newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: OPTIONS - EOE TRADE DOMINATED BY INDEX CALLS.
newsitem.headline: OPTIONS - EOE TRADE DOMINATED BY INDEX CALLS.

text.p: Trade on the AEX contract dominated European Options Exchange (EOE) trade on Wednesday as market makers continued to sell calls at or above the market.
EOE contract calls outnumbered puts by around 23,000 to 8,600, with the combined taking a 24 percent of total business.
Dealers said continued selling of calls at these levels would increase the downward pressure on the underlying index in the coming days, ahead of the expiry of October options Friday.
Some dealers said this could send the index to below 585 points, but much depended on what happened on Wall Street.
